title: WaveformTileRequest
description: Arguments for get_waveform_tile. The RESPONSE is NOT JSON: it is a raw binary payload (tauri::ipc::Response -> ArrayBuffer). Little-endian layout: [magic u32 = 0x41575446 'AWTF'][version u16 = 1][channels u16][lod u32][tileIndex u64][bins u32] followed by channels*bins pairs of (min i16, max i16), where i16 full scale (32767) maps to +1.0 linear. Bin width = 2^(8+lod) source samples; a tile spans binsPerTile = 1024 bins.

clipId.description: UUID of the clip whose waveform pyramid is queried.

lod.description: Level of detail. Bin width in source samples = 2^(8+lod): lod 0 = 256 samples/bin, lod 1 = 512, ... Higher lod = coarser.

tileIndex.description: Zero-based tile index at this LOD. Tile n covers bins [n*1024, (n+1)*1024).
